description: This bar chart illustrates the effect sizes of six multilingual BERT models—mBERT-L₂, mBERT-R₂, mBERT-B₂, XLM-L₂, XLM-R₂, and XLM-B₂—across nine linguistic categories: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The horizontal axis lists these linguistic categories in order from left to right, while the vertical axis represents the effect size, labeled “effect,” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, marked with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each linguistic category is represented by a group of six stacked bars, each corresponding to one of the six models as indicated by the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). The height of each bar indicates the mean effect size for that model within the category, with error bars extending above and below each bar to indicate variability. The bars are not sorted by value; they appear in the order of the linguistic categories listed on the x-axis. Visually, the tallest bars are found in the IE-Indic category, particularly for mBERT-R₂ (approximately 20) and mBERT-B₂ (approximately 23), while the shortest bars are in the Isolate category, where all bars are near zero. The Semitic category shows high effect sizes for XLM-L₂ (approximately 15) and XLM-B₂ (approximately 20), and the IE-Slavic family category shows moderate effect sizes for mBERT-B₂ (approximately 15) and XLM-B₂ (approximately 15). No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining beyond their standard color coding.
